description:
Perform a one-way MANOVA in Jamovi using the loaded 'ExamAnxiety.csv' dataset. The goal is to analyze whether 'Gender' (Independent Variable) has an effect on the combined academic outcomes: 'Exam' score, 'Anxiety' level, and 'Revise' time (Dependent Variables).

1. Ensure 'Gender' is set as a nominal/factor variable.
2. Run a One-Way MANOVA with 'Exam', 'Anxiety', and 'Revise' as Dependent Variables and 'Gender' as the Grouping Variable.
3. Enable 'Pillai's Trace' for the multivariate test.
4. Enable 'Univariate Tests' to see individual effects.
5. Enable 'Box\'s M Test' to check assumptions.
6. Save the results to a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/manova_results.txt' following the format:

MANOVA Results
Multivariate Test (Pillai's Trace): [value], F=[value], p=[value]
Univariate Tests:
  Exam: F=[value], p=[value]
  Anxiety: F=[value], p=[value]
  Revise: F=[value], p=[value]
Box's M: [value], p=[value]

7. Also save the Jamovi project file to '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety_MANOVA.omv'.
